text:
maria: FYI a user hit an import failure when deploying to edge. They get `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for @redwood/inference-sdk.

aditya: Oof. Do we have the installed package.json from their environment?

maria: They shared the tarball manifest. Quick paste:```
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference-sdk",
  "version": "0.12.3",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "dist/index.cjs",
      "import": "dist/index.cjs.mjs"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "sourceMap": false
}
```

maria: The `import` entry points at `dist/index.cjs.mjs` (double extension). That explains edge ESM resolver failing.

sophie: We've had the rollup plugin append the compiled extension previously when we asked it to rewrite imports. Looks like the plugin ran twice.

aditya: Also `sourceMap` is false and types were missing in some published packs last month. Makes debugging harder for end users.

maria: Repro steps I used: 1) npx create-next-app toy 2) npm i @redwood/inference-sdk@0.12.3 3) import { Client } from '@redwood/inference-sdk' 4) push to Vercel -> build fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND

aditya: Quick fix path: republish 0.12.4 with corrected exports mapping. e.g. set exports import -> `./dist/index.mjs` and require -> `./dist/index.cjs`.

sophie: Long-term: add a release-time validation that unpacks `npm pack` and verifies every path referenced in package.json (main/module/exports/types) exists in the tarball. If mismatch -> fail publishing job. Also ensure we emit sourcemaps and include types in the package.

maria: I'll open a PR to fix the rollup/tsc publish step to avoid double-appending extensions and to enable source maps for published artifacts.

aditya: I'll prepare a canary republish. For immediate mitigation, tell the affected user to import deep path `@redwood/inference-sdk/dist/index.mjs` in their edge function until we republish.

sophie: Also add a tiny lint script that scans built `dist` for files that contain `index.cjs.mjs` or other suspicious double-ext patterns. We can run that in CI before pack.

build-bot: Release pipeline check failed for 0.12.3: missing files in tarball ["dist/index.mjs", "dist/index.d.ts"], and found `dist/index.cjs.mjs` which is unexpected. :warning:

aditya: Thanks build-bot. I'll tag a hotfix and coordinate the republish. Who wants the PR? @sophie?

sophie: Taking it. I'll also add the `npm pack` inspection step to the release GH action and a short note in release docs: run `npm pack` locally and inspect tarball contents (tar -tf) before publishing.

maria: Client reported workaround worked. They're unblocked for now. Please set an npm deprecation on 0.12.3 pointing to the patched version once published.

aditya: Will do. I'll push artifacts to the release branch and publish scoped canary first for internal teams.

sophie: Postmortem item: "publish: double-extension in exports caused ESM imports to fail". Add link to PR + CI check.

maria: Thanks. Closing loop once 0.12.4 is published and deprecation posted. :thumbsup:
